Lumbard & Kellner Increases Position in Time Warner (TWX); Bailard Has Raised Its Stake in Apple (AAPL) by $5.34 Million
May 27, 2018 - By Migdalia James
Lumbard & Kellner Llc increased its stake in Time Warner Inc (TWX) by 43.67% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Lumbard & Kellner Llc bought 14,180 shares as the company’s stock rose 1.97% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 46,653 shares of the television services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.27 million, up from 32,473 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Lumbard & Kellner Llc who had been investing in Time Warner Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $73.67B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.10% or $0.09 during the last trading session, reaching $94.17. About 2.46 million shares traded. Time Warner Inc. (NYSE:TWX) has declined 3.25% since May 27, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 14.80% the S&P500.
Thomas Bailard increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 18.22% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Bailard Inc bought 31,614 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The hedge fund run by Thomas Bailard held 205,172 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $34.72 million, up from 173,558 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Bailard Inc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $926.90 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.23% or $0.43 during the last trading session, reaching $188.58. About 15.45M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 27, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Bailard Inc, which manages about $2.27 billion and $1.59B US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Gilead Sciences Inc (NASDAQ:GILD) by 6,694 shares to 38,082 shares, valued at $2.73M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in International Business Machs (NYSE:IBM) by 15,750 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 13,125 shares, and cut its stake in Snap On Inc (NYSE:SNA).
